# Evaluación probabilística del peligro sísmico (PSHA)

## Resumen ejecutivo {#sec-hazard_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/hazard.summary.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/hazard.results.es.qmd",
    stem = "hazard-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(
      ID.target = ID.gmdp,
      p.target = "mean",
      Tn.target = Tn.PGA
    ),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-hazard-summary-site",
    context = "resumen de peligro"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
```

```{r}
    path = "/_fig/RMw2D.ES.qmd",
    stem = "hazard-rmw",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,

    level = 4L,
    anchor = "sec-hazard-rmw-site",
    context = "figuras RMw"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/RMw.ES.qmd",
    stem = "hazard-rmw-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),

}
```
